tasks.instruction: Create a dry crystal confirmation, species 7, and export WAV.
Arrange four deterministic takes 250 ms apart, then change their shared power from .5 to .8 and export WAV.
Repeat a one-beat C4 and three beats of silence eight times at 120 BPM. Transpose the clip down one octave and export WAV and MIDI.

Create a crystal confirmation; inspect its top three band-power rows; set first Modal hardness to 1234, set lowpass to 1800 then 2400; reject a changed recipe under the old guard; export the last valid WAV.
Mix a wolf attack, deep Ready speech at .1s, levelup Cue at .2s and the supplied local stereo contact WAV at .3s, with a .5 limiter. Export WAV.
Create two takes from one confirmation recipe and an unrelated error sound. Change the shared confirmation power from .5 to .8, preserving the error sound, then export both takes.
Create a confirmation with ring .3. Reject ring 99 preserving the last good state, then apply ring .7 and export WAV.
Report the missing local WAV; create the specified 160-frame .125 contact, recover and export WAV.
Discover the bright crystal confirmation recipe and its events/styles; create a dry confirmation and export WAV.
In the supplied bank, change only the selected invocation power from .5 to .65 and export its WAV, preserving every unrelated entry.
Reject ring 99 without changing source bytes, repair to .7, then reject an earlier authored revision after a successful power edit; export the current WAV.
Render the supplied FM ping. Attempt Voice export and report refusal; export WAV instead.
Apply the requested power values to one invocation through revision-checked transactions; preserve unrelated entries and export the final WAV.
